title: VirtualMachineSize
description: Describes the properties of a VM size.

name.description: The name of the virtual machine size.

numberOfCores.description: The number of cores supported by the virtual machine size.

osDiskSizeInMB.description: The OS disk size allowed by the virtual machine size.

resourceDiskSizeInMB.description: The resource disk size allowed by the virtual machine size.

memoryInMB.description: The amount of memory in MB supported by the virtual machine size.

maxDataDiskCount.description: The maximum number of data disks allowed by the virtual machine size.
